description: Double-diamond × safe-prereg for IDEA exploration. Diverge widely (≥7 alternatives). Seal at DEFINE. Develop the picked; archive the rest as restartable seeds. Ripen against the frozen seal.

seams_with_seal: discover -> define_audience (gate: candidate count >= 7 AND diversity score >= 60)
define_audience -> define_seal (gate: each surviving candidate has 3 audience archetypes OR is kill-recommended)
define_seal -> develop (SEAL FIRES: each surviving candidate has sealed-prereg with sha256_pre_verdict; predict/kill/apoha FROZEN)
develop -> deliver (gate: every non-developed candidate persisted as unsown-seed with seal-hash intact)

discover_to_define_audience.kill_if: fewer than 7 candidates surfaced — DISCOVER stays open

define_seal_to_develop.kill_if: any surviving candidate missing any of the four sealed fields — DEFINE_SEAL stays open

develop_to_deliver.kill_if: any unsown-seed is missing its sha256_pre_verdict OR fails canonical re-hash

safe_prereg_discipline.default: DEFINE_SEAL auto-creates sealed-prereg artifacts; if user skips sealing, DEVELOP runs anyway with WARN 'running unsealed — this is observation, not verification'; DELIVER emits UNVERIFIED instead of RIPENED.
safe_prereg_discipline.opt_in_tightening: Set protocol.seal_required = true to refuse DEVELOP without sealed-pre-regs and refuse RIPENED without seal-3 integrity-check.

conductor_mode.summary: Claude Code thread reads this standard JSON and conducts WITH the user through each phase inline. User has agency at each seam. The thread is the conductor; the user is the soloist; the agent JSONs are the score's voice-leading cues.
conductor_protocol: For each phase, read the named agent's `_charter` and `_charter.apoha`, then enter that phase's intent in plain prose to the user.
Refuse to advance through a seam until the seam's gate condition is met. If the gate is not met, name what's missing in plain English; do not silently skip.
At DEFINE_SEAL: state the proposed predict + kill_condition + apoha aloud, ask the user to confirm or refine, then compute sha256_pre_verdict over the agreed text. Cite the seal hash explicitly.
Treat archived unsown-seeds as restartable later — explicitly name them in DELIVER so the user knows what's preserved.

dispatch_mode.summary: Subagent-per-phase. Each agent JSON compiles to a `.claude/agents/<slug>.md` for dispatch via Claude Code's Task tool. Conductor (parent thread) dispatches each phase as a subagent and reads the return value.
dispatch_mode.core_definitions_shared: Both modes use the SAME agent JSONs and the SAME standard JSON. The mode chooses HOW the score is read (conducted-with-user inline, or dispatched-as-subagent), not WHAT the score says.

execution_modes.score_is_the_same: The standard JSON IS the score. The agent JSONs ARE the players. Conductor-mode and dispatch-mode are two ways to render the same score; user has agency in both, default is conduct-with-user.

_note: Two-step DEFINE (define_audience + define_seal) is the lane-specific shape — the audience-receiver check happens BEFORE the seal so we don't seal an audienceless idea. Universal bootstrap (project-bootstrap-v0) collapses DEFINE into one phase via `problem-definer`. Both shapes valid; this template's two-step is the idea-exploration tilt.
